title: message.received
description: A text message arrived on an agency's connected WhatsApp number. Non-text and undecryptable messages are skipped at the source. Carries no tenantId: the consumer resolves the tenant from `phone`, the agency's connected number.
x-tenant-resolution: phone (the agency's connected WhatsApp number) -> tenant, looked up by agency-app/api scripts/whatsapp-message-processor.js

messageId.description: WhatsApp message id; consumers dedupe on it

phone.description: Same as `to`; the agency's connected number
